title: Caption karaoke
description: Use for word-by-word spoken captions where each word fills with colour as it is said (talking heads, voice-overs). The `captions` prop is a @remotion/captions Caption[].
props: {captions: Caption[]; maxWordsPerPage?: number /*4*/; color?: string; highlightColor?: string /*'#ffd54a'*/; fontSize?: number; fontFamily?: string /*'Montserrat, sans-serif'*/}
